name: arXiv API negative search: no paper titled TensorRT-LLM
notes: TITLE search (ti:) for 'TensorRT-LLM' against the arXiv API returns opensearch:totalResults 0 - an empty feed, zero entries. This is a stronger negative than a keyword sweep because it is the search a reader trying to FIND the paper would run first, and it is empty. Confirms the absence of a system paper for TensorRT-LLM. Checked 2026-10-04. Recorded because a citation invented for this project would be a fabrication on a system the repo already tracks as engines/tensorrt-llm, with a real observability record (obs-tensorrt-llm-observability) and FLOP records that describe its kernels.
